question: What is the value of 1.4 × 1.4 + 1.2 × 1.2 + 1.3 × 1.3?
solution:
**Given:**

Expression: 1.4 × 1.4 + 1.2 × 1.2 + 1.3 × 1.3

Concept Used 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf549d8ed75068c5cb44a816a55d9099b0dc62c590018619be535a10a0dde6b1.png] 

**Calculation:**

1.4 × 1.4 = 1.96

1.2 × 1.2 = 1.44

1.3 × 1.3 = 1.69

Sum = 1.96 + 1.44 + 1.69

⇒ 5.09

**The value of the expression is 5.09.**
